name: AUREVYX — Website Engineering & Intelligence Platform
author: sobhitjadoun

sections.description:
AUREVYX is a professional Website Engineering and Intelligence platform designed for WordPress developers, agency engineers, and site owners who demand architectural visibility into their websites.

AUREVYX is NOT simply an SEO plugin. It provides a comprehensive engineering cockpit evaluating the foundational pillars of high-performance web engineering:

  • Site Discovery & Structure: Inspects robots.txt directives, search engine visibility configurations, permalink structures, and public URL enumeration.
  • Foundational SEO: Evaluates title tag configuration, checks for default placeholder taglines, and audits metadata length.
  • Performance & Runtime: Audits PHP memory allocations, benchmarks active plugin footprints, and inspects object caching layers.
  • Security & Hardening: Evaluates SSL enforcement, checks open user registration exposure, verifies production error display settings, and inspects administrative file editing postures.
  • Database & Storage Health: Monitors MySQL table counts, storage fragmentation overhead, and expired transient accumulations.

Privacy & Zero-Telemetry Guarantee

AUREVYX runs 100% locally on your WordPress server.
* No external API calls are made by the core plugin.
* No data, telemetry, URLs, or code are transmitted to third-party or remote servers.
* All calculations and audits occur entirely within your own server environment.

AUREVYX Pro (Optional Commercial Addon)

For advanced engineering teams requiring deep infrastructure diagnostics, AUREVYX Pro is available as an optional separate addon:

  • Pricing: AUREVYX Pro is available as Pro Monthly ($9/month) or Pro Yearly ($89/year — Save $19/year).
  • Pro Engines: Multi-hop recursive deep crawler, automated WCAG 2.2 accessibility verification, static code syntax analyzer (AST dead-code shaker), visual regression & layout shift detection, autonomous AI root-cause diagnostics, and continuous 24/7 background telemetry.
  • The Free plugin contains ONLY Free functionality. Actual Pro implementation code exists exclusively in the separate AUREVYX Pro plugin package.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aurevyx folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the AUREVYX menu in your WordPress admin bar.
  4. Click Run Quick Audit to generate your site’s initial Engineering Health Index.
sections.faq:
Does AUREVYX slow down my website?

No. AUREVYX is architected with performance-first principles. It does not load any CSS or JavaScript on your frontend visitors’ pages. Audits are executed either on-demand by administrators or via background WP-Cron schedules.

Does AUREVYX send data to external servers?

No. The Free AUREVYX plugin executes 100% locally on your WordPress host. It does not phone home, does not collect analytics or tracking telemetry, and does not transmit website content externally.

What is the difference between AUREVYX Free and Pro?

AUREVYX Free provides comprehensive site discovery, title & SEO audits, PHP runtime checks, security hardening checks, and MySQL database bloat monitoring. AUREVYX Pro adds recursive multi-hop web crawling, WCAG 2.2 accessibility testing, static theme code intelligence, and AI-powered root-cause repair diff generation.

How is AUREVYX Pro priced?

AUREVYX Pro offers two subscription options: Pro Monthly ($9/month) and Pro Yearly ($89/year, recommended with 17.6% savings). Both plans include all Pro engines, updates, and white-label PDF reports.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

By default, AUREVYX preserves your historical audit data in case you re-activate. If you wish to completely delete all custom database tables upon removal, you can enable the “Wipe Data on Uninstall” option under Settings > Platform Settings prior to deleting the plugin.
